Paytable

Pride & Trait Vault use Lazy Lions the operator holds — every paying symbol is a whole Lion, named for the trait it wears. Top to bottom: Crown #4230, LAZY Hat #5216, Shades #4522 and Leopard Fur Coat #482 as premiums; Bucket Hat #4837, Monocle #840, BTC Eyes #5813 and Sheriff #1506 as mids; Police Hat #2038, Horns #1725, Pirate Hat #4117 and Black Cap #5348 as lows.
Cub Cluster uses Lazy Cubs instead: #21095 and #3097, Cub LAZY Hat and Money Mouth, with the real Lazy Drinks NFTs as the low pair — Lazy Milk (higher) and Lazy Juice.
WILD and the $LAZY scatter are original art; WILD is still blocked by the licensing gate, because none of the 120 owned Lions is a Signature Series. Lazy Juice is the operator's own Drinks NFT (11 held); Lazy Milk is used on asserted permission rather than holdings, and is recorded that way in the manifest.
Play money only — no wallet, no $LAZY, no chain. Strip weights, paytables, win caps and the HMAC-SHA256 derivation are the verified production values.
